_why: #18 part 2. H3 closes the exit gate only over the SAME leg set, so a cycle that recorded no legs silently reset a streak nobody was counting. Each mutation carries its own `test` key.

mutations.name: the-legs-default-is-removed
mutations._mechanism: Back to opt-in: a cycle records no legs, H3 cannot fire, and the exit streak resets invisibly.

mutations.name: the-default-clobbers-an-explicit-legs
mutations._mechanism: An explicit --legs may name a leg the wrapper did not dispatch (a teammate or doc-auditor pass collected by hand). Clobbering it makes that leg unnameable.

mutations.name: the-default-is-set-before-surfaces-resolve
mutations._mechanism: Set too early it copies an EMPTY array, so the wiring looks present and records nothing -- the defect wearing the fix's clothes.
mutations.replace:
local -a _surf
  if [ "${#legs[@]}" -eq 0 ]; then legs=("${_surf[@]}"); fi
  if [ -n "$surfaces" ]; then
